prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Columbus. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I make recommendations: which Columbus do you mean (Columbus, OH; Columbus, GA; other)? And what kind of tanning are you interested in — UV tanning beds, spray/airbrush (sunless), or red-light/LED treatments? Any preferences for price, late hours, or neighborhood?

If you want to skip that and want general guidance now, here’s a practical plan you can use immediately:

Which specific salons to call (call 3–5)
- A well-known national chain (e.g., Palm Beach Tan) — why: consistent standards, multiple locations, often good for first-timers and package deals.
- A top-rated local spray-tan specialist — why: better sunless results, trained technicians and custom airbrush for even color.
- A local tanning salon with high reviews that offers multiple bed levels (low/medium/high) — why: flexibility if you want gradual color or stronger sessions.
- A value or late-night studio (if you want cheap or off-hours) — why: lower cost or hours that fit your schedule.
- A studio offering specialty services (red light therapy, collagen, etc.) — why: if you want skin-repair / wellness benefits in addition to color.

What to ask when you call (short script)
- “Do you offer UV tanning beds, spray/airbrush, or both?”
- “Which type/brand of beds do you have and do you have low-, medium-, and high-pressure options?”
- “Do you offer a consultation for first-timers and will staff recommend an appropriate first session length based on my skin type?”
- “What are your prices for single sessions, first-time specials, and monthly packages?”
- “Are your spray tans custom-matched and do technicians do an in-person airbrush? What prep/care do you recommend?”
- “What safety measures and cleaning protocols do you follow? Do you provide protective eyewear and disposable undergarments for spray tans?”
- “Do you require appointments for spray/airbrush and what is cancellation policy?”

How I can help next
- If you tell me which Columbus and a ZIP or neighborhood plus the kind of tanning you want, I’ll pull 4–6 specific salons near you, with addresses, phone numbers, typical pricing, and quick pros/cons for each.
